title: Verdict Schema
description: Schema for validation verdicts generated by The Validator.

action_id.description: Unique identifier of the simulated attack action.

mttd_seconds.description: Mean Time To Detect in seconds.

matched_evidence_ref.description: Reference ID of the matched evidence event.

causal_chain.description: Sequence of reasoning steps that produced the verdict.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the detection rule that was validated.

technique_ref.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique reference associated with the rule.
